Visitor replaces superscript with custom template

```go title="Go"
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	htmd "github.com/xberg-io/html-to-markdown/packages/go/v3"
)

type testVisitorVisitorSuperscriptCustom struct {
	htmd.BaseVisitor
}

func (v *testVisitorVisitorSuperscriptCustom) VisitSuperscript(ctx htmd.NodeContext, text string) htmd.VisitResult {
	return htmd.VisitResultCustom(fmt.Sprintf(`^%s^`, text))
}

func main() {
	options := htmd.ConversionOptions{}
	visitor := &testVisitorVisitorSuperscriptCustom{}
	options.Visitor = visitor
	result, err := htmd.Convert(`<p>Einstein's E=mc<sup>2</sup> revolutionized physics.</p>`, &options)
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	fmt.Printf("%+v\n", result.Content)
}
```
